defs.def: the direction that is on your left when you watch the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass 北；北方

ex.s: 36    We dance from Florida to Alaska, from north to south and sea to sea.
ex.t: 36 我们从佛罗里达到阿拉斯加，从北到南、从海到海地跳舞。

ex.s: The Alberta hail project is managed by Terry Krauss, a cloud physicist who works for Weather Modification Inc of Fargo, North Dakota.
ex.t: 阿尔伯塔防雹项目由特里·克劳斯管理，他是一名云物理学家，任职于北达科他州法戈的天气改良公司。

ex.s: It was a cold March day in High Point, North Carolina.
ex.t: 那是北卡罗来纳州海角市三月寒冷的一天。

defs.def: the northern part of a country, a region or the world 北部；北部地区

ex.s: There are now 700 elderly people looking after hens in 20 care homes in the North East, and the charity has been given financial support to roll it out countrywide.
ex.t: 如今英格兰东北部20家养老院里有700名老人在照料母鸡，该慈善机构已获得财政支持，计划在全国范围内推广。

ex.s: In the north of India, the population is booming due to high birth rates, but in the south, where most economic development is taking place, birth rate is falling rapidly.
ex.t: 在印度北部，由于高出生率，人口正在激增，但在大多数经济发展正在进行的南部，出生率正在迅速下降。

ex.s: It is in the north of China.

defs.def: the NE states of the US which fought against the South in the American Civil War （美国南北战争时与南方作战的）北部各州，北方

ex.s: New York City is located in the north-east of the US and was already a big city by then.
ex.t: 纽约市位于美国东北部，当时已经是一个大城市。

defs.def: the richer and more developed countries of the world, especially in Europe and N America 北方发达国家（尤指欧洲和北美各国）

ex.s: My two sets of grandparents lived in Colorado and North Dakota, and my parents decided to spend a few weeks driving to those states and seeing all the sights along the way.
ex.t: 我的两对祖父母分别住在科罗拉多州和北达科他州，父母决定花几周时间开车去那些州，沿途看遍所有景点。

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.s: Harbour Air is the largest seaplane airline in North America, flying 30,000 commercial flights in 40 seaplanes each year.
ex.t: 港湾航空是北美最大的水上飞机航空公司，每年用40架水上飞机执行30,000次商业航班。

ex.s: One of the most wonderful migrations in nature is that of the North American monarch butterfly.
ex.t: 自然界中最奇妙的迁徙之一，是北美帝王蝶的迁徙。

ex.s: Thanksgiving is celebrated mainly in North America, in October or November.
ex.t: 感恩节主要在北美， 10月或11月庆祝。

ex.s: What was a cause of the waterfowl population decline in North America?
ex.t: 北美水禽数量下降的原因是什么？

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在整个殖民时期，烟草在弗吉尼亚、马里兰和北卡罗来纳被用来代替硬币或纸币，尽管它在殖民地其他地方以及整个欧洲和英国也被广泛使用。

defs.def: in or towards the north 北方的；向北的；北部的

ex.s: They went farther north into the deep forests of Canada, where there were fewer humans around.
ex.t: 它们向北迁移进入加拿大深处的森林，那里人类较少。

ex.s: In China, it spends the warmer months in the rivers and wetlands in the north-east.
ex.t: 在中国，它在较温暖的月份生活在东北的河流和湿地中。

defs.def: a north wind blows from the north 北风的；北方吹来的
towards the north 向北；朝北
nearer to the north than sth 某物以北

ex.s: The house where Reisley has lived for 73 years is located in the woods of Westchester County, New York, just 30 miles north of Manhattan.
ex.t: Reisley住了73年的房子位于纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的树林里，距曼哈顿以北仅30英里。

ex.s: While they are rare north of 88°,there is evidence   61   they range all the way across the Arctic, and as far south as James Bay in Canada.
ex.t: 虽然它们在88°以北很少见，但有证据____61__它们分布横贯整个北极，最南到加拿大的詹姆斯湾。

defs.def: more or higher than sth 超过

chunks.cn: 航空公司 在…里 北
